notes.title: Language Update – Alaric Speaks Chinese!
notes.notes:
Mini Update – Now Available in Simplified Chinese!

Hey adventurers!

We’re happy to announce that Alaric’s Quest is now available in Simplified Chinese (简体中文).
More players can now join Alaric on his dangerous journey through deadly traps and tricky platforms.
📌 What’s new in this update:

    ✨ New language added: Simplified Chinese (zh-CN).

    All UI and in-game texts have been updated to support the new language.

    Minor fixes to some multilingual text formatting.

If you spot any translation issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out!
Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Alaric's Quest – Beta Showcase (“Speedrun” with God Mode by the Dev)
notes.notes:
[p]Join this special Steam Broadcast of [i]Alaric's Quest[/i], where I — the solo dev — will be playing through the [b]near-final beta[/b] of the game.
Let’s call it a “speedrun” in quotes: I’ll show (almost) every level, skip a few buggy spots, and yes, occasionally get lost.[/p][p]Oh, and I’ll be using [b]God Mode[/b], because not even the developer can survive [i]everything[/i]. It’s a feature in the game, available for less skilled players — like me.[/p][p]🎯 What to expect:[/p][list][*][p]Full (or almost full) level showcase[/p][/*][*][p]Developer “speedrun” with cuts and detours[/p][/*][*][p]God Mode gameplay for accessibility[/p][/*][*][p]No commentary — just pure platforming[/p][/*][/list][p]Tune in to get a real feel for the game before launch[/p]

notes.title: Alaric's Quest – Live Gameplay with the Developer!
notes.notes:
[p]Join me for a live gameplay session of *Alaric's Quest*! 🎮

I'll be playing through the demo and showing what makes this old-school platformer unique: tight controls, extreme difficulty, secrets, and a good dose of '90s cartoon nostalgia.

Whether you're into Ghosts 'n Goblins or Alex Kidd, you'll feel at home – or c[b]ushed by lava.[/b][/p]
